description: A rank-2 weight stored column-major: logical [out, in], storage [in, out]. What a GEMM lowering asks for when it wants the B operand un-transposed at the call site.
name: torch.transposed
provenance: RANK 2 ON PURPOSE, and this is the one place the closed vocabulary is narrower than the idea. `transposed` in inductor means 'the last two axes are swapped', which is defined at any rank; a record has to name ONE map, and a rank-3 swap and a rank-2 swap are two maps. The rank-2 entry is the one every Linear weight needs and the only one anything on this fleet has asked for. A wider one is a NEW record (`transposed-3d@1`), never a widened `rank` on this one — that would silently change what an existing stamp means.

MEASURED CONTEXT (tcg#80 phase 1, banked in research/layout-morphisms/0-DESIGN.md §10): the compiled SDXL UNet issues 883 GEMMs as extern calls. The B-operand arrangement is an input to every one of them.
